host.title: UniFi Host
host.description: IP or hostname of your UniFi OS console/gateway (e.g. 10.1.0.1) or self-hosted controller

port.title: Port
port.description: HTTPS port: 443 for UniFi OS consoles, 8443 for a self-hosted UniFi Network Application

site.title: Site Name
site.description: UniFi site name — visible in the URL of your controller dashboard

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to fetch WAN stats. 5 seconds is the recommended minimum.

rejectUnauthorized.title: Verify SSL Certificate
rejectUnauthorized.description: Disable for self-signed certificates (standard for local controllers)
